fusions.name: Seam Collapse
fusions.desc: Hurls a slab of ore-bearing rock that deals 22 rock damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Hematite Teeth
fusions.desc: Drives spikes of raw ore up through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 rock damage to everything in it and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Lodestone Draw
fusions.desc: Raises a lodestone seam 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Laid Down in Strata
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
